fieldValues.title: srs-rust releases stopped for 34 hours: GitHub refused the macOS runner, every Release run was cancelled, and nobody was told
fieldValues.summary: From 2026-11-06 01:49 UTC, every srs-rust Release run on master was cancelled: both macOS legs (os: macos-14) got 'The configuration macos-14-arm64-us-default is not supported' within a second, so draft, corpus gate and promote were skipped. Six runs in a row. The last published release is v0.1.0-build.616 (2026-11-05 18:25 UTC). Work merged and closed since (RFC-053 srs-rust#1591, RFC-044 [R11] #1590, RFC-045 slice 1 #1589) is not in any release, so no pin can advance and srs#1007 and srs-web#742 wait. The cycle report of 2026-11-07 did not see it; the analyst found it by checking whether a release carries #1591.
evidence: 2026-11-07: srs-rust Release runs on master cancelled at 2026-11-06 01:49, 08:36, 14:26, 16:47, 21:52, 21:52 UTC; latest https://github.com/the-greenman/srs-rust/actions/runs/42300311033, annotation: The configuration 'macos-14-arm64-us-default' is not supported
2026-11-07: filed as bug srs-rust#1592; srs#1007 and srs-web#742 now blocked by it
fieldValues.body:
- Where it stopped: Review and land. The PRs merged green, their issues closed, but the work never reached a release, which is what consumers pin.
- Why nobody saw it: a cancelled run is not a red one; CI on master stayed green, and no report or routine reads the Release workflow.
- Fix in hand: srs-rust#1592 (move the macOS legs to a supported runner label). The wider gap is that release health has no watcher.
